title: circular convolution Mirror
hypothesis: When role-specific linear functions are generated by unit-spectrum HRR circular-convolution views of one shared expert, a shared expert plus fixed HRR role addresses will recover their held-out outputs at substantially lower actual payload bytes than untied experts; MAP/sign-permute, Hadamard, Givens, tying, and low-rank residual controls will identify whether the effect is specific to the circular-convolution address family.
physical_object: One shared 16x12 linear expert matrix and shared output bias
mirror_coordinate: Four deterministic unit-spectrum HRR circular-convolution address operators, reconstructed from a charged 64-bit seed and algorithm metadata
targeted_literature: Practical Lessons on Vector-Symbolic Architectures in Deep Learning-Inspired Environments (Carzaniga et al., 2025; PA11)
Learning Holographic Reduced Representations with Clifford Variational Autoencoders (arXiv:2609.28409)
qFHRR: Rethinking Fourier Holographic Reduced Representations through Quantized Phase and Integer Arithmetic (arXiv:2604.25939)
controls: tied plus rank-1 private matrix residual
teacher: Aligned condition builds four role matrices by applying deterministic unit-spectrum real circular-convolution operators to one shared 16x12 matrix. Independent condition samples arbitrary matrices per role. The HRR address seed is charged and identical between the aligned teacher and the HRR model.

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE over all methods and both conditions; common learning rate selected before fresh access

amendments.reason: The development aggregate selection metric selected 0.003, but a command-line mistake launched the original fresh seeds at 0.01. The original fresh outputs are excluded. This amendment uses the already development-selected 0.003 without examining or tuning from those exploratory outputs.

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes from torch.save state_dict plus deterministic configuration/address seed metadata
paid_objects: shared or untied expert matrices and biases

success_gate: In all three fresh aligned worlds, HRR MSE <=1.10x untied and actual serialized bytes <=0.65x untied. Report relative quality and payload against every MAP, Hadamard, Givens and low-rank control. This gate establishes an HRR-aligned mechanism only, not superiority over other bindings generally.
failure_gate: In both development worlds, HRR misses either the 1.10x untied-quality or 0.65x untied-byte gate. Keep fresh seeds sealed after failure.
boundaries: Teacher is intentionally aligned with HRR circular convolution
Fixed 1200-update screen, not near-convergence capacity evidence
No natural-language, nonlinear MoE, or general HRR superiority claim
Seeded fixed HRR codes are charged as metadata but not learned
